title: Model Serving and Scheduling
summary: This module manages the serving of language models via HTTP endpoints, orchestrates model loading and execution using a scheduler, and provides caching for model metadata and recommendations.

nodes.label: Client Request
nodes.title: External Client Request
nodes.description: An incoming request from a client application or user, typically via HTTP, for model interaction or information.

nodes.label: Serve Llama Models
nodes.title: Llama Model Server
nodes.description: Starts an HTTP server to serve Llama-based models, handling requests for loading, embeddings, and completions.

nodes.label: Serve Ollama Models
nodes.title: Ollama Model Server
nodes.description: Starts an HTTP server to serve Ollama-compatible models, managing loading, embeddings, and completions.

nodes.label: Manage Model Scheduling
nodes.title: Model Scheduler
nodes.description: Orchestrates the loading, unloading, and execution of models, managing GPU/CPU resources and handling concurrent requests.

nodes.label: Cache Model Information
nodes.title: Model Info Cache
nodes.description: Caches model metadata and show responses to optimize repeated requests for model details and configurations.

nodes.label: Provide Model Recommendations
nodes.title: Model Recommendations API
nodes.description: Registers API routes to deliver curated lists of recommended models to users.

nodes.title: Llama.cpp Inference Engine

nodes.label: Ollama Core Engine
nodes.title: Ollama Core Inference Engine
nodes.description: The core Ollama engine responsible for managing and running models.

nodes.label: GPU/System Resources
nodes.title: Hardware Resources
